key.name: quick-replies
key.default: ["Yes, perfect", "On my way", "I'll call you back"]
key.description: Replies offered under an incoming message. Up to three are shown.

key.name: use-accent-color
key.description: Color the pill with the accent color of the desktop instead of amber.

key.name: call-control
key.summary: Answer and decline calls from this computer
key.description: Turn on call control in the engine as soon as an iPhone is linked.

key.name: phone-language
key.description: The language the drawings of the iPhone screens are written in: "en", "fr", or empty to guess from the languages of this computer.

key.name: muted
key.description: Nothing from the iPhone pops up on this computer until this is turned off again.

key.name: follow-do-not-disturb
key.summary: Stay quiet in Do Not Disturb
key.description: While Do Not Disturb is on, nothing from the iPhone shows in the top bar; unread messages are only counted.

key.name: quiet-while-sharing
key.summary: Stay quiet while the screen is shared
key.description: The same silence while the screen is shared or recorded.

key.name: calls-through-do-not-disturb
key.summary: Let calls through in Do Not Disturb
key.description: Show incoming calls even while Do Not Disturb is on.

key.name: phone-audio-here
key.summary: Play iPhone audio on this computer
key.description: Music and sounds of the iPhone play through this computer. Kept by the phone link service; this key mirrors it for Phone Settings.

key.name: lock-on-away
key.summary: Lock this computer when I walk away with my iPhone
key.description: Kept by the phone link service; this key mirrors it for Phone Settings.

key.name: lock-away-seconds
key.description: Seconds between the moment the iPhone is noticed gone and the lock.

key.name: battery-alerts
key.summary: Tell me when the iPhone battery is low
key.description: One quiet notification at 20 % and one at 10 %.

key.name: forget-request
key.description: Set by Phone Settings to ask the Shell to open "Forget This iPhone…"; put back to false at once.
